enabled.description: Add the Traefik annotations to the Service.

forceTLS.description: Talk to the backend over HTTPS. Adds the `traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/service.serversscheme: "https"` annotation.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS verification of the backend. Allows HTTPS backends with self-signed certificates.

serverName.description: Server name (SNI) Traefik uses when talking to the backend.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name with the release fullname.

name.description: Name of the ConfigMap. Expanded to `fullname-name` unless `expandObjectName` is `false`.

configMapRef.description: A ConfigMap with the CA certificate.

name.description: Name of the Secret. Expanded to `fullname-name` unless `expandObjectName` is `false`.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name with the release fullname.

secretRef.description: A Secret with the CA certificate.

items.description: A ConfigMap or Secret with a certificate authority. Set `configMapRef` or `secretRef`.

rootCAs.description: ConfigMaps or Secrets, in the same namespace, with certificate authorities Traefik uses to verify the backend.

description: Traefik settings for the backend of the Service, set as annotations on the Service.
